args.body:
Combined summary of Saltmarsh freight pieces (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/freight + insights.saltmarsh.example/freight/companion):

- Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Freight Pricing Q2 2026 — Combined Summary (Saltmarsh)
